training.data_named: OpenWebText (GPT-2 BPE tokens); Sudoku puzzles from the Alp (2024) generator, 48,000 30-clue training puzzles
training.compute_printed: approximately ten days on eight NVIDIA H200 GPUs (1M-step run)

main_sampler.description: w-deterministic reverse sampler: z_s drawn from Cat(rho_s|t), w_s set to the conditional Dirichlet mean; z_t denoiser input, constant concentration eta = 0.01; temperature chosen per configuration and NFE by entropy matching

credited_component.text: exact Dirichlet–categorical augmentation of uniform discrete diffusion

design.other_detail: D01: uniform substitution channel augmented by an auxiliary shifted-Dirichlet simplex variable w_t. D11 other: simplex state w_t carried between reverse steps. D15 other: Rao-Blackwellized reverse-bridge KL averaged over auxiliary categorical decodes (simplex-relaxed continuous-time analogue of the UDLM objective), constant loss weighting.
design.inherited_from: uniform discrete diffusion / UDLM (Schiff et al., 2025); categorical diffusion framework of Hoogeboom et al. (2021) and Austin et al. (2021)

census.F2_detail: w-deterministic sampler: z_s sampled from Cat(rho), w_s set to its Dirichlet mean; temperature selected per configuration and NFE from 15 values 0.84-1.12 by generated entropy closest to 5.44, selected value not printed (temperature part NS); terminal decoding 'Ancestal sample' (Table 7); no truncation or guidance stated.

setting.value_rule_printed: temperature selected from 0.84 to 1.12 by generated entropy closest to 5.44
